description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit: a fitted forest-green tunic with wide gold bands at the collar and the hem, long cream sleeves, a brown belt, brown trousers and soft folded brown boots. Seen from behind: the back of the forest-green tunic with its gold hem band, brown trousers and soft brown boots. Simple bold shapes, no fine pattern. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
